title: Blaming the Machine, Billing the Victim? How Mock Jurors Reassign Fault from Generative AI Systems and Respond to Liability Cliffs in Tort
abstract: arXiv:2611.32188v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative AI complicates tort liability attribution when people blame a generative AI system that cannot itself bear legally relevant fault. We investigate where this blame goes when fault must be allocated among legal persons, and whether American discontinuous apportionment doctrines influence mock jurors' factual findings of fault. Such doctrines include Contributory negligence, Joint and several liability, and their 50% or 51% variations, all of which have a fault-percentage threshold or a "cliff" where the victim-entitled compensation (or a defendant's liability) jumps to zero (or to all compensatory damages). Our pre-registered human subjects experiment (N=199 Prolific participants) shows that as many U.S. mock jurors (36%) blame the AI system itself, the AI blame often "leaks" to the victim or to the AI user (in 27% to 73% of our AI-blaming records, depending on how leakage is calculated). translated_title: 《责怪机器，让受害者买单？模拟陪审员如何将过错从生成式AI系统重新归责，并回应侵权法中的“责任断崖”》
translated_abstract: 生成式AI使侵权责任归属问题变得复杂，因为人们会将过错归咎于一个本身在法律上无法承担责任的生成式AI系统。我们研究了当过错必须在法律主体之间进行分配时，这种指责会转移到何处，以及美国的不连续分摊规则是否会影响模拟陪审员对过错的事实认定。此类规则包括过失相抵、连带责任及其50%或51%的变体，它们均设有过错百分比阈值或“断崖”，使得受害者应得的赔偿（或被告的赔偿责任）会骤然降为零（或骤升为全部赔偿金）。我们开展的预注册人类受试者实验（N=199名Prolific参与者）显示，多达36%的美国模拟陪审员会直接归咎于AI系统本身，而对AI的指责常常“泄漏”到受害者或AI使用者身上（根据泄漏的计算方式不同，在对AI归责的记录中占27%至73%）。尽管模拟陪审员很少改变（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 本研究通过199人的预注册实验发现，美国模拟陪审员常将过错归咎于法律上无法担责的生成式AI系统，且这种指责会“泄漏”到受害者或AI使用者身上，同时侵权法中的责任断崖规则（如过失相抵、连带责任）会影响陪审员的过错认定。
en_tdlr: A pre-registered experiment (N=199) reveals that U.S. mock jurors frequently blame generative AI systems that legally cannot bear fault, with such blame "leaking" onto victims or AI users, while discontinuous apportionment doctrines create liability cliffs that shape fault findings in tort cases.
